entities.summary: Omar Abdul Razaq, or Umar Abed al-Razek, is a Palestinian politician and professor. He served as the Minister of Finance in the First Haniyeh Government. He represents the Hamas organization, and was arrested by Israel on 29 June 2006 and freed in 2008. He is a professor and researcher in the Department of Economics at An-Najah National University.
